unit_attributes.statement: If a creditor, within 60 days after having transmitted to an obligor a statement of the obligor's account in connection with an extension of consumer credit, receives at the address disclosed under section 1637(b)(10) of this title a written notice (other than notice on a payment stub or other payment medium supplied by the creditor if the creditor so stipulates with the disclosure required under section 1637(a)(7) of this title) from the obligor setting forth or enabling identification of the obligor's name and account number (if any), indicating the obligor's belief that the statement contains a billing error and the amount thereof, and setting forth reasons for that belief (to the extent applicable), the creditor must, not later than 30 days after receipt of the notice, send a written acknowledgment thereof to the obligor, unless the obligor has, after giving such notice and before the expiration of the specified time limits, agreed that the statement was correct, or unless the action required in subparagraph (B) is taken within such 30-day period.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If a creditor, within sixty days after having transmitted to an obligor a statement of the obligor’s account in connection with an extension of consumer credit, receives at the address disclosed under section 1637(b)(10) of this title a written notice (other than notice on a payment stub or other payment medium supplied by the creditor if the creditor so stipulates with the disclosure required under section 1637(a)(7) of this title) from the obligor meeting paragraphs (1)-(3), unless the obligor has, after giving such written notice and before the expiration of the time limits herein specified, agreed that the statement was correct.

unit_attributes.statement: If a creditor, within 60 days after having transmitted to an obligor a statement of the obligor's account in connection with an extension of consumer credit, receives at the address disclosed under section 1637(b)(10) of this title a qualifying written billing error notice from the obligor, the creditor must, unless the obligor has agreed the statement was correct, not later than two complete billing cycles of the creditor (in no event later than 90 days) after receipt of the notice and prior to taking any action to collect the amount or any part thereof indicated by the obligor under paragraph (2), either: (i) make appropriate corrections in the obligor's account (including crediting any finance charges on amounts erroneously billed), transmit to the obligor a notification of such corrections and an explanation of any change in the amount indicated, and, if any such change is made and the obligor so requests, provide copies of documentary evidence of indebtedness; or (ii) satisfy the requirements of clause (ii).
unit_attributes.scope_text: If a creditor receives qualifying notice from an obligor within sixty days after transmitting an account statement in connection with consumer credit, and the obligor has not agreed the statement was correct.

unit_attributes.statement: Under the procedure upon receipt of a qualifying billing error notice, as an alternative to making corrections under clause (i), the creditor must, not later than two complete billing cycles of the creditor (and in no event later than 90 days) after receipt of notice and prior to taking collection action, send a written explanation or clarification to the obligor, after having conducted an investigation, setting forth to the extent applicable the reasons why the creditor believes the account was correctly shown in the statement and, upon request of the obligor, provide copies of documentary evidence of the obligor’s indebtedness.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When a creditor has received qualifying written notice of a billing error and does not make corrections under clause (i), unless the obligor has agreed the statement was correct.

unit_attributes.statement: In the case of a billing error where the obligor alleges that the creditor's billing statement reflects goods not delivered to the obligor or his designee in accordance with the agreement made at the time of the transaction, a creditor must not construe such amount to be correctly shown unless he determines that such goods were actually delivered, mailed, or otherwise sent to the obligor and provides the obligor with a statement of such determination.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In the case of a billing error where the obligor alleges that the creditor’s billing statement reflects goods not delivered to the obligor or his designee in accordance with the agreement made at the time of the transaction

unit_attributes.statement: After complying with the provisions of subsection 1666(a) with respect to an alleged billing error, a creditor is not required to have any further responsibility under this section if the obligor continues to make substantially the same allegation with respect to such error.
unit_attributes.scope_text: After complying with the provisions of this subsection with respect to an alleged billing error, if the obligor continues to make substantially the same allegation with respect to such error.
